topic: Biggest risks facing the Q3 platform migration
headline: Top Risks Before We Cut Over
summary: A prioritized view of the risks most likely to derail the Q3 platform migration if left unaddressed.
key_points: No rollback plan tested beyond staging
Database migration script unverified against production-scale data
Two on-call engineers unfamiliar with the new infrastructure
Customer-facing API contract changes not yet communicated
Load testing incomplete for peak traffic scenarios
